questionnaire.title: SAM Flow AI Intake Questionnaire
questionnaire.description: Welcome to SAM Flow AI. This questionnaire helps us understand your business and generates your personalized revenue plan.

questions.title: Revenue Goal & Timeframe
questions.description: What revenue are you aiming for, and over what period?

fields.name: revenueGoal
fields.label: Revenue Goal
fields.helpText: Enter the revenue you want to reach

questions.title: Products & Pricing
questions.description: What do you sell? List your main offerings with pricing.

fields.name: products
fields.label: Your Products/Services
fields.helpText: Add each product with price and whether it's one-time or recurring

questions.title: What's Worked & What Hasn't
questions.description: Tell us about your wins and your struggles. This helps us recommend the right initiatives.

fields.name: successfulInitiatives
fields.label: What has driven real results for you?
fields.helpText: Select everything that has worked for you

fields.name: failedInitiatives
fields.label: What has NOT worked or flopped?
fields.placeholder: e.g., Cold calling has low conversion. Generic emails get high unsubscribe rates.
fields.helpText: This helps us avoid recommending approaches that won't work for you

questions.title: Ideal Customer
questions.description: Who are you trying to reach?

fields.name: idealCustomer
fields.label: Describe your ideal customer
fields.placeholder: e.g., Mid-market B2B service companies, $2M-$20M revenue, CEO/COO decision makers, pain point: team alignment
fields.helpText: Be specific: role, company size, pain point, budget

questions.title: Current Assets
questions.description: What do you already have? (email list, social followers, website traffic, customers)

fields.name: emailListSize
fields.label: Email List Size
fields.helpText: How many people on your email list?

fields.name: socialFollowing
fields.label: Social Media Following
fields.helpText: Combined followers across LinkedIn, Twitter, etc

fields.name: existingCustomers
fields.label: Number of Existing Customers
fields.helpText: Customers you can reach out to

questions.title: Budget & Team
questions.description: What's your marketing budget and who's on your team?

fields.name: monthlyMarketingBudget
fields.label: Monthly Marketing Budget
fields.helpText: What can you spend on marketing each month?

fields.name: teamSize
fields.label: Team Size
fields.helpText: How many people on your marketing/sales team?

fields.name: teamRoles
fields.label: Team Roles
fields.helpText: What roles are on your team?

sampleAnswers.failedInitiatives: Cold calling (low conversion), generic email blasts (high unsubscribe), YouTube advertising (wrong audience)
sampleAnswers.idealCustomer: Mid-market B2B service companies ($2M-$20M revenue). Decision makers: C-suite executives (CEO, COO, Head of Sales). Pain point: leadership team misalignment and ineffective delegation. Annual training budget: $50K+.
